title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: SharePoint list agent creates Microsoft Lists from prompts
summary: The briefing's feature description, roadmap facts, general licensing statement and blocking operation are supported. Minor corrections should acknowledge the Registry navigation documented elsewhere by Microsoft and identify the checklist's permission checks that have no corresponding controls row.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn has no dedicated page for this list-creation agent at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "SharePoint list agent"; "list agent" "Copilot" create default license permissions. Read release-notes entry 534606; results about adding lists as knowledge describe a different capability, not a dedicated page for this agent.

claims.where: Why it matters: existing behaviour

claims.quote: Searched: "SharePoint list agent"; "SharePoint list agent" admin default enabled block. Read roadmap and release-notes entry; they describe creating lists through prompts, not replacing an existing workflow or changing existing lists.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; rendered controls table
claims.claim: The documented blocking route is Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > agent > Block.
claims.quote:
Select Agents > All agents.
In the All agents page, select an agent from the list of agents.
In the agent details pane that opens, immediately under the agent's name, select Block or Unblock.
claims.fix: The cited action page supports the printed route, but https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-agent-365/admin/agent-registry-overview explicitly includes Registry. Cite that page and use 'Agents > All agents > Registry > agent > Block'; include Registry in the Before rollout inventory-check route too.

claims.quote:

claims.where: controls[0].governs; rendered controls table
claims.claim: The existing agent block/unblock control restricts access across the organisation.
claims.quote: Block or unblock agents for the entire organization by using the same controls that work for any other app in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.where: Governance controls: selected agent
claims.claim: The agent-management action applies to the selected agent.
claims.quote: These actions apply to the selected agent. If the agent is included in a plugin, don't assume the action also applies to the whole plugin package, its skills, shared MCP servers, or connections.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout and After rollout
claims.claim: The checklist's checks of list access permissions have corresponding governance-control rows.
claims.quote: Before rollout: "record which site each list lands on and who can open it." After rollout: "Review the lists the pilot group created for column quality and permissions." The sole control row covers blocking or unblocking an agent.
claims.fix: The Before rollout check of who can open each list and the After rollout review of list permissions have no corresponding controls-table row; identify these as the checklist-to-table coverage gap.
